retrievalProfile.description: A dynamic layout featuring a series of vertical rectangular panels receding into a deep vanishing point against a black background, anchored by large foreground elements and metallic display text.

recipe.visualDefinition: A series of vertical rectangular cards arranged in a linear perspective that recedes from the right foreground to a distant vanishing point on the left. The foreground card is highly textured and large-scale, while the background is solid black. Gold-toned sans-serif typography is positioned in the upper left corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Linear perspective creating extreme depth from right to left
High contrast between vibrant card imagery and solid black negative space
Size hierarchy where the rightmost element dominates the frame
Top-left alignment of text balancing the right-side visual weight
coreInvariants: Vertical rectangular aspect ratio for all receding elements
Consistent vanishing point on the horizontal midline

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary subject is a large, textured rectangular panel on the far right, with progressively smaller panels trailing off to the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, wood-textured panel in the immediate foreground right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the large foreground panel, follows the receding line of cards to the left, and then moves up to the gold text in the top left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive black negative space occupying the entire left and bottom-left quadrants.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black background for maximum contrast.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm wood tones and varied photographic colors within the cards.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Metallic gold for the primary display typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the dark background and the brightly lit foreground elements.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid bright primary colors in the background
Maintain gold or metallic sheen for text

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family with varying weights.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, modern, and geometric aesthetic of the reference.
Provides a similar high-readability geometric structure.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a black background with a series of vertical rectangular panels (album covers) receding into a vanishing point on the far left. The rightmost panel should be very large and show a detailed wood grain texture. The panels should have varied photographic content.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three lines of left-aligned geometric sans-serif text in the top-left corner using a metallic gold color.

verificationChecks: Is the perspective receding to a single point on the left?
Is the text in the top-left corner gold and sans-serif?
Does the rightmost panel dominate the foreground?

adjustableVariables: Specific gold hue of the text
postGenerationChecks: Check for consistent lighting across the receding panels
Ensure the gold text has a subtle metallic sheen
Verify the vanishing point creates a sense of infinite depth
Confirm the foreground panel has visible tactile texture
recipe.reuseFormula: Receding Perspective + Black Background + Gold Geometric Typography + Textured Foreground Anchor
